title: Honey Bitter
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shuri Otokawa was born able to read minds and spent years in fear and isolation; she decides to live more positively after starting work at her aunt's investigation agency (MANGA MILLION blurb via AniList; MangaUpdates). Readers describe her working cases with a partner, Youta, while dealing with trauma from an abusive ex-boyfriend, Riki, who raped her (MangaUpdates user comments). A 14-volume josei-leaning shoujo mystery romance from Shueisha's Cookie.
life_message: It suggests that a person can recover from trauma and learn to trust and love again (to verify).

content.note: Crime cases; Shuri's aunt strikes the ex (user comments); AniList Terrorism tag (to verify).
Detective cases and Shuri's fear and phobia from past abuse (AniList Detective; MangaUpdates Phobia/s, user comments).
